I replied to Pree in a thread on her #central-random message: the ticket is #8841.

Tobias posted it in #central-random yesterday (Oct 13, 9:27), so Pree can see it herself. He said West yard Door 2 is still double-booking when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk, and that he had flagged it on ticket #8841 for support.

His message calls it "Tobias's dealer account" and doesn't name Marrow Fieldworks. I linked it to Marrow Fieldworks through the Central handoff digest from January. That digest is a public file, and it says Marrow Fieldworks, Pree's dealer account at the time, changed hands on Jan 5. That suggests it's now Tobias's, but nothing says so outright. I told Pree that, and suggested she check with Tobias before the call. I also warned her not to mix it up with #88412, an older Tansleigh Packaging ticket about Door 6.

I only used channels Pree belongs to and public files. Nothing in the reply needed approval.
